## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky26

Cherry-picks all four commits from [PR #34](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/34).

### Opt-in cached-success checks

`bazel build` and `bazel test` accept `--experimental_cache_probe_output=<file>` to identify selected targets that lack reusable local or remote cache successes. The option is unset by default.

- Cache misses mark targets as affected without executing build or test spawns or uploading cache entries. Only passing cached test results count as successes.
- Missing targets are printed as provisional progress. A complete JSON manifest is written atomically after all selected targets and test results are accounted for. Invocation, analysis, or cache errors prevent publication of a complete manifest.
- `--experimental_cache_probe_exclude_deps` excludes package prefixes and targets depending on them through declared rule labels before analysis. Excluded packages are not loaded. Dynamically resolved toolchain and aspect dependencies are not examined by this exclusion step.
- Build tag filters also apply to tests and test-suite members in this mode.

The mode requires `--keep_going` and `--test_keep_going`. It does not support `--build_tests_only`, streamed test output, or the check-up-to-date options. After a cache miss, later derived dependencies may be skipped; the manifest is not a substitute for a build or test run. Native file-writing actions, cache downloads, and local bookkeeping can still write files. Minimal remote downloads do not verify the availability of every CAS blob.

### Validation

The cache-checking shell integration suite and eight complete Java targets passed on Linux x86_64 remote execution: ActionsTests, ExecTests, RemoteTests, RuntimeTests, CacheProbeCompletionTest, ActionTemplateExpansionFunctionTest, ParallelBuilderTest, and SkyframeTests. Validation used a local BuildBuddy toolchain override to identify its GCC compiler correctly for the integration suite's `wabt` dependency; no release source or tests were changed for that override. Shell syntax, patch equivalence, whitespace checks, and all 21 mocked publication checks passed.

### Release publication

Linux and macOS binaries for x86_64 and arm64 are built and version-checked before publication. The immutable release includes SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance attestations.
